stops.note: literally out of one's cape, describing slipping free and leaving a pursuer holding only the cloak
carried into French for slipping free from capture or danger
stops.meaning: to slip free from capture or danger

stops.note: settled as the English word for breaking free from confinement or danger
stops.meaning: to break free from confinement or danger

current_meaning: to break free from confinement, danger, or an undesirable situation
